title: The canonical cone projection of a short exact sequence is a quasi-isomorphism
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category, and let $0\to X\xrightarrow{f}Y\xrightarrow{g}Z\to0$ be a short exact sequence of cochain complexes. The canonical morphism $p:\operatorname{Cone}(f)\to Z$, equal to $g$ on the unshifted $Y$ summand and zero on the shifted $X$ summand, is a quasi-isomorphism.

proof.text: Apply the already proved Mathlib theorem CochainComplex.mappingCone.quasiIso_descShortComplex to the short exact short complex S. Its morphism descShortComplex S is defined as mappingCone.desc S.f 0 S.g. Mathlib inr_descShortComplex and inl_desc give its two stated summand restrictions.
